description: Pixel art game resource for Tumble Toy, a cute handmade toy-block puzzle game. Pastel sky blue, cream, mint, peach, coral-pink and dark-plum palette; crisp hard pixels; simple readable shapes; charming toy-room style; no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no photorealism, no smooth antialiasing. Use the supplied composition guide. A joyful vertical main-menu hero illustration: one large blank cream, mint and peach six-sided toy die tumbling gently above exactly three pastel toy floor blocks and one small coral goal diamond, quarter-view isometric, centered with generous transparent margins. Every die face must remain completely blank for a clean logo-like silhouette. No pips, dots, holes, spots, numerals, letters, symbols, characters, faces, scenery, frame or opaque backdrop.
